Key Responsibilities:   Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.  Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.  Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.  Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;  Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral  Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels  Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures  Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements  Net-worth monitoring;  Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.  Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.  Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.  Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.  Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.    Requirements:   Legally resident in Brazil.  Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.  Demonstrated  independence from commercial functions  and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.   Strong knowledge of  Central Bank of Brazil  risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.   Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.  Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.  Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in  Portuguese and English  .   Must meet  fit and proper  standards with  no disqualifying factors  , including:   not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;  unblemished reputation;  knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;  technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.  not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

description:

ABOUT US  Syniti  , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.  Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.  Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.  Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.  THE ROLE   We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven  Technical Product Owner  to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.  What You’ll Do   Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.  Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.  UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.  Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.  Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.  Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.    WHAT IT TAKES   The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).  The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.  The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.  The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.  The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.  The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.    Key Skills    Visionary Leadership:  Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.   Advanced Governance Concepts:  Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.   AI/ML Application:  Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.   Visual Communication:  Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.   Technical Storyboarding:  Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.   Relationship Orchestration:  Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.  Drive for Results:  Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.    Be fully aligned with our core values:  Think Big  - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.  Be Curious  - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.  Take Action  - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.  Stronger Together  - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.  By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.   WHAT WE OFFER   Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.  Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.  Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.  Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.  Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.  An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.    OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION  At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.  We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Technical product owner
description:
Confira a vaga para Technical product owner em cambé. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

ABOUT US  Syniti  , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.  Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.  Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.  Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.  THE ROLE   We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven  Technical Product Owner  to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.  What You’ll Do   Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.  Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.  UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.  Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.  Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.  Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.    WHAT IT TAKES   The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).  The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.  The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.  The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.  The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.  The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.    Key Skills    Visionary Leadership:  Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.   Advanced Governance Concepts:  Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.   AI/ML Application:  Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.   Visual Communication:  Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.   Technical Storyboarding:  Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.   Relationship Orchestration:  Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.  Drive for Results:  Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.    Be fully aligned with our core values:  Think Big  - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.  Be Curious  - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.  Take Action  - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.  Stronger Together  - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.  By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.   WHAT WE OFFER   Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.  Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.  Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.  Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.  Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.  An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.    OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION  At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.  We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
Confira a vaga para Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em caxias do sul. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Nature Co  Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.  Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.  We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.     Role and responsibilities   The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.  The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.  Primary roles and responsibilities include:   Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management   Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.  Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.  Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.  Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.    Eligibility, due diligence & agreements   Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).  Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation  Lead closure of contract signatures.  Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system   (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).  Reforestation delivery enablement   Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.  If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.  If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.  When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:   Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule  Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).  Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.    Minimum Requirements:   Portuguese as a first language.  C1 or C2 Level English Speaker  University degree in English Teaching or related area.  One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.  Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.  Must pass a criminal background check.  Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.    Who we are:   Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Technical product owner
description:
Nova oportunidade para Technical product owner em rio do sul. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

ABOUT US  Syniti  , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.  Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.  Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.  Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.  THE ROLE   We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven  Technical Product Owner  to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.  What You’ll Do   Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.  Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.  UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.  Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.  Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.  Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.    WHAT IT TAKES   The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).  The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.  The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.    Key Skills    Visionary Leadership:  Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.   Advanced Governance Concepts:  Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.   AI/ML Application:  Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.   Visual Communication:  Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.   Technical Storyboarding:  Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.   Relationship Orchestration:  Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.  Drive for Results:  Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.    Be fully aligned with our core values:  Think Big  - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.  Be Curious  - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.  Take Action  - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.  Stronger Together  - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.  By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. title: Risk management officer
description:
Confira a vaga para Risk management officer em ribeirão preto. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Us  Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.  Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.  As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.  Key Responsibilities:   Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.  Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.  Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.  Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;  Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral  Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels  Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures  Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements  Net-worth monitoring;  Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.  Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.  Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.  Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.  Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.    Requirements:   Legally resident in Brazil.  Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.  Demonstrated  independence from commercial functions  and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.   Strong knowledge of  Central Bank of Brazil  risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.   Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.  Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.  Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in  Portuguese and English  .   Must meet  fit and proper  standards with  no disqualifying factors  , including:   not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;  unblemished reputation;  knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;  technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.  not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: English teacher with advanced portuguese skills
description:
Confira a vaga para English teacher with advanced portuguese skills em bragança paulista. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.  If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.  What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?  You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.  If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.  When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:   Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule  Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).  Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.    Minimum Requirements:   Portuguese as a first language.  C1 or C2 Level English Speaker  University degree in English Teaching or related area.  One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.  Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.  Must pass a criminal background check.  Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.    Who we are:   Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Oracle cloud finance functional consultant
description:
Confira a vaga para Oracle cloud finance functional consultant em presidente prudente. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Descrição do Cargo  Experiência no setor de saúde é desejável, com bom entendimento de sistemas de saúde, operações clínicas, etc.  Mínimo de 8 a 10 anos de forte experiência trabalhando com Oracle Cloud Financials – módulos GL, FAH, EDMCS e AR.  Experiência em projetos de suporte e melhorias (enhancements).  Experiência em desenho e implementação de soluções de sistemas para processos financeiros principais, especialmente nas áreas de  Records to Report (R2 R) e  Order to Cash (O2 C) .   Capacidade de liderar de forma independente o desenho e a transformação da estrutura empresarial, como mapeamento de COA (plano de contas), razão (ledger) e estrutura de unidades de negócio (BU) para empresas complexas.  Experiência no desenho de soluções para contabilidade regulatória, como FERC.  Forte habilidade na criação de modelos complexos de alocação para CAPEX, Receita e OPEX.  Forte experiência na configuração do Oracle Cloud GL e Accounting Hub para mapeamento de plano de contas (COA), incluindo o desenho de interfaces complexas com sistemas externos.  Experiência na criação de relatórios complexos utilizando Smart View, FRS, BI Publisher e OTBI.  Forte conhecimento de ferramentas de integração como FBDI, Webservices e familiaridade com OIC, incluindo componentes Oracle Paa S.  Experiência na criação de documentos de design funcional para objetos RICE e na coordenação com equipes técnicas e funcionais durante design, desenvolvimento, testes e implantação.  Responsável por gerenciar o desenho e a entrega ponta a ponta de objetos RICE de alto volume (Interfaces, Conversões, Extensões e Relatórios).  O profissional deve ter fortes habilidades de comunicação para interagir com diversos stakeholders e experiência em todas as fases do projeto: planejamento, levantamento de requisitos, análise de gaps, design, configuração, testes e treinamento, implantação e suporte.
